description: A one-permit semaphore: t.a takes it at 0 and holds it until 300. t.b (from 10) waits under time::timeout with 100 ns: the timeout's Sleep registers its timer on the first poll that finds the acquire pending, fires at 110, and the step is Elapsed (ASX_E_TIMED_OUT); the dropped acquire leaves the line. t.b then acquires again and is handed the permit by t.a's release at 300, not a stale waiter's.
